items.summary: Recommendation: preserve containment-only execution. Continue existing measurement, attribution reconciliation, failed-work repair-or-close review, and bounded legal/security evidence work. Reject new production requests, requeues, experiments, duplicate telemetry, spend, monetization expansion, and unsupported financial claims. Evidence: 27 deployed improvements await measurement, 7 requests failed, 46 repair follow-ups remain open, and only 1 outcome is proven. Revenue covers 2026-09-21 only: $4.92 aggregate commission and $0 site-attributed commission; AI cost was $963.57 from 2026-09-01–2026-09-26. ROI, margin, causal lift, and cost-to-learn remain unknown. Keep SearchWoot private. The one remaining owner decision is whether to authorize the prepared Woot permission request after human-counsel review or keep it unsent.
